description:
Gapper Scanner (FREE preview) — 5-pillar low-float momentum gap scan
(gap >=10%, price $1-$100, float <=100M, premarket volume >=50k; relative volume ranks the board and news is flagged; independent implementation, defaults differ from any educator's published
criteria). Finds cheap small-cap stocks gapping up hard, flagging which have a
news catalyst.

This free, no-key endpoint auto-picks the live session — pre-market gappers
during 04:00-09:30 ET, after-hours gainers during 16:00-20:00 ET — and returns
the top 10 on the default filters (up >=10% vs the session's
reference close, price $1-$100, float <=100M shares, extended-hours volume >=50k).

Each gapper: symbol, name, sector, last (extended-hours price), changePct (TRUE
gap vs the reference close), atr, rvol (DERIVED premarket relative volume =
premarketVolume / avgVolume, i.e. what fraction of a normal FULL day's volume has
already traded — NOT TradingView's regular-session relative volume, which is
meaningless before the bell), premarketVolume (extended-hours volume), avgVolume,
float, rsi, and hasNews (a boolean catalyst flag — headline text and article
links are not served here). Ranked by cleared pillars first, then premarket relative volume descending. The result echoes
'session'.

Want to force a session, tune the filters, pull up to 50 names, and unlock the
full 51-tool connector (live options flow, GEX magnet levels, unusual activity,
wheel screeners)? Get a TraderMatrix API key — see the '_upgrade' field.
name: get_premarket_gappers
